Pim's broken signal tower on the Far Side before the CALL, seen directly as an environment key. The Northern Relay signal tower is 40 m tall, on a vast empty dark slate plain. Its base is an octagonal weathered grey stone plinth 8 m wide, supporting a tapering stone shaft divided into three stepped stages. An old open brass bracing frame surrounds the upper stage. A small circular brass service gallery sits just below the top at 36 m, with a one-metre rail. Above the gallery are four large cracked rectangular signal mirrors in simple brass frames; one frame leans, and the topmost mast is snapped. Several fine wires remain physically fastened to the brass top frame and trail down and to the right in the wind. Tarnished brass, old matte stone, a few clean cracks, no glowing machinery. Other fallen signal towers lie dark and toppled along the far horizon. No inhabited buildings. One lone tiny moth-folk officer is only a scale speck on the upper gallery: 1.4 m tall plus 30 cm antennae, cream ruff, a lilac vest, folded pale wings, two upright feathery antennae, no headset; no facial detail at this distance. Keep him smaller than 1/23 of the tower's total visible height. No other people. The overwhelming impression is silence and loneliness. Camera 5 m high at a distance of about 100 m, mild upward angle, full tower including grounded base and snapped top visible with clear margins, horizon low behind the lower fifth of the tower. Named key light: dim diffuse pale-violet skylight from upper left beneath a violet-black starless sky; the lit plane of the stone is slate-violet and the shadow a simple darker cool shape. The sky remains darkest navy-violet, and a thin pale-violet upper-left cloud band explains the light; no moon or sunlight. Brass catches a few small pale highlights. Tower dominates centre-left; cracked mirrors reflect only dim sky shapes. No working beacon, no fire, no magical rings, no rift frame in this direct view. Broad plain stretches to the horizon with sparse drawn ground cracks and large flat value shapes, absolutely no depth-of-field or cinematic fog. The tiny officer stands with one hand on the gallery rail, antennae up, looking out over the plain.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
